Implementing D_min minimization and deriving the correlation function requires careful translation of the paper's equations, but the underlying physics is documented and not novel; typical of a multi-part algorithm needing domain knowledge.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of four dependent stages: amorphous sample building, compression MD run, stress-strain computation, and correlation-length extraction. Each stage requires correct LAMMPS scripting or post-processing; while not extremely long (2.5 ns simulation, modest I/O), the dependencies and need for proper force-field parameterisation make orchestration moderately complex.
